name: Child Protection Act
blurb: Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act 2004, section by section.
tips: Memorise section numbers, ages (child is under 18; Part VII proceedings under 15), time limits and penalties.
Learn the Board's composition and the CPO's powers, then the Parts of the Act in order.
Check the latest text on punjablaws.gov.pk because the Act was amended after 2004.

name: Child Rights & Law
blurb: UNCRC, child-related laws in Pakistan, child protection practice and scenarios.
tips: Know UNCRC article numbers and the four general principles.
Link each law to its year: JJSO 2000, Zainab Alert Act 2020, Child Marriage Restraint Act 1929.
Practise scenario questions: the first action is almost always the child's safety.

name: Social Sciences
blurb: Social work, psychology, sociology and criminology.
tips: Learn who founded or developed each theory or method; PPSC likes name-to-concept matching.
Compare similar terms side by side (casework vs group work, primary vs secondary prevention).
Revise stages and models as lists: Erikson, Piaget, Kohlberg.

name: Pakistan Studies
blurb: History, constitution, geography, economy and culture of Pakistan.
tips: Make a timeline from 1857 to 1973 and attach constitutions and amendments to it.
Learn firsts and superlatives: first, largest, highest, longest.
Revise provinces, rivers, dams, minerals and CPEC facts once a week.

name: Islamic Studies
blurb: Quran, Seerah, Khulafa, hadith and Islamic history.
tips: Memorise years of battles and events in the Hijri calendar.
Know the Khulafa-e-Rashideen, the Sihah Sittah and their authors.
Revise pillars, articles of faith, and basic fiqh counts (for example fard acts of wudu).

name: Current Affairs
blurb: Pakistan and world current affairs, institutions, organisations and days.
tips: Read one national newspaper section daily for the last 6 to 12 months before the test.
Focus on appointments, awards, treaties, summits and international days.
Verify office-holders the day before the exam: they change.

name: GK & Geography
blurb: World geography, capitals, inventions, books, sports and awards.
tips: Learn capitals and currencies in small groups of ten.
Revise the longest, highest, largest and deepest lists.
Pair inventions with inventors and books with authors.

name: Everyday Science
blurb: Physics, chemistry, biology, health and environment.
tips: Learn SI units and symbols; they appear every time.
Know vitamin deficiency diseases and common diseases with their causes.
Understand everyday applications: why the sky is blue, how a fuse works.

name: Computer & IT
blurb: Computer basics, MS Office, internet, networking and cyber safety.
tips: Practise Word, Excel and PowerPoint shortcuts on a real computer.
Know file extensions, memory units and number systems.
Learn Excel functions (SUM, IF, VLOOKUP) and cell references.

name: English
blurb: Vocabulary, idioms, grammar, voice, narration and spelling.
tips: Do ten vocabulary words daily with synonyms and antonyms.
Master tenses, voice and narration rules with quick patterns.
Learn common prepositions with their verbs and adjectives.

name: Urdu
blurb: اردو ادب، قواعد، محاورے اور ضرب الامثال
tips: اردو شعرا اور ان کی کتب کی فہرست یاد کریں۔
محاورے اور ضرب الامثال کے مطلب مثالوں کے ساتھ پڑھیں۔
واحد جمع، مذکر مؤنث، مترادف اور متضاد کی مشق کریں۔

name: Maths & Reasoning
blurb: Basic maths, series, ratio, percentage and mental ability.
tips: Memorise squares, cubes and fractions to percentages.
Use shortcuts for percentage, ratio, average and simple interest.
In series questions, check differences, ratios and squares first.
